Docket 1.3.127

**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes), $349, or 4 payments of $87.25, to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *Broken structured data is explained by its cause.* When the same JSON-LD mistake appeared on several
  pages at different places, the report counted it as several different errors and warned that fixing
  one would not be enough, when one fix covered them all; it also fell back to a general list of causes.
  It now groups them by cause and gives the specific fix.
- *An unfilled template tag is named.* When a page's template prints its own tag, such as
  `{{ studio.phone }}`, into the structured data instead of a value, the report now names the tag and its
  line and says to fix the template, instead of quoting the parser and suggesting a trailing comma.

99 checks across 13 areas.
